inputs.text: Open your eyes and look at what they are really doing. Taoiseach Micheál Martin was pushing the official line in Limerick this past week about housing tenancies increasing, but it is all a total smokescreen designed to hide their true agenda. They are trying to make us ignore the real story behind the calculated surge in eviction notices and homelessness, which was orchestrated right after their new rules on March 1 forced landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. This isn't just some accidental bureaucratic failure at all; it is a deliberate, coordinated squeeze disguised as regulation. Why else would the numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again? They are the ones creating the crisis, controlling the narrative, and spinning the statistics just to keep us all in the dark.
